verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.on: וּמַלִיל יְיָ עִם מֹשֶׁה לְמֵימָר
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe saying:

oe.t: Adonoy spoke to Moshe saying:

verses.he: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אִשָּׁה֙ כִּ֣י תַזְרִ֔יעַ וְיָלְדָ֖ה זָכָ֑ר וְטָֽמְאָה֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים כִּימֵ֛י נִדַּ֥ת דְּוֺתָ֖הּ תִּטְמָֽא׃
verses.on: מַלֵל עִם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמֵימָר אִתְּתָא אֲרֵי תְעַדִי וּתְלִיד דְכָר וּתְהֵי מְסָאָבָא שִׁבְעַת יוֹמִין כְּיוֹמֵי רִחוּק סוֹבְתַהּ תְּהֵי מְסָאָבָא
verses.en: Speak to Bnei Yisroel, saying, when a woman conceives and gives birth to a male child she will be ritually unclean for seven days; as the days of her menstrual flow, she will be unclean.

oe.t: Speak to Bnei Yisroel, saying, when a woman conceives and gives birth to a male child she will be ritually unclean for seven days; as the days of her menstrual flow [
the state of her impure ‘separation’
], she will be unclean.

verses.he: וּבַיּ֖וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֑י יִמּ֖וֹל בְּשַׂ֥ר עָרְלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וּבְיוֹמָא תְּמִינָאָה יִגְזַר בִּסְרָא דְעָרְלְתֵהּ
verses.en: On the eighth day, the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

oe.t: On the eighth day, the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

verses.he: וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים יוֹם֙ וּשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים תֵּשֵׁ֖ב בִּדְמֵ֣י טָהֳרָ֑ה בְּכָל־קֹ֣דֶשׁ לֹֽא־תִגָּ֗ע וְאֶל־הַמִּקְדָּשׁ֙ לֹ֣א תָבֹ֔א עַד־מְלֹ֖את יְמֵ֥י טָהֳרָֽהּ׃
verses.on: וּתְלָתִין וּתְלָתָא יוֹמִין תֵּיתֵב בְּדַם דְכוּ בְּכָל קוּדְשָׁא לָא תִקְרַב וּלְמִקְדְשָׁא לָא תֵעוֹל עַד מִשְׁלַם יוֹמֵי דָכוּתַהּ
verses.en: For thirty-three days she will remain [in the status] that the blood [she sees] is ritually pure. She shall not touch anything holy and she shall not come into the Sanctuary, until the days of her purity are completed.

oe.t: For thirty-three days she will remain [in the status] that the blood [she sees] is ritually pure. She shall not touch anything holy and she shall not come into the Sanctuary, until the days of her purity are completed.

verses.he: וְאִם־נְקֵבָ֣ה תֵלֵ֔ד וְטָמְאָ֥ה שְׁבֻעַ֖יִם כְּנִדָּתָ֑הּ וְשִׁשִּׁ֥ים יוֹם֙ וְשֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים תֵּשֵׁ֖ב עַל־דְּמֵ֥י טָהֳרָֽה׃
verses.on: וְאִם נְקוּבְתָא תְלִיד וּתְהֵי מְסָאָבָא אַרְבְּעָה עֲסַר כְּרִחוּקַהּ וְשִׁתִּין וְשִׁתָּא יוֹמִין תֵּיתֵב עַל דַם דְכוּ
verses.en: If she gives birth to a female she will be unclean for two weeks as during her menstruation. For sixty-six days she will remain [in the status] that the blood [she sees] is ritually pure.

oe.t: If she gives birth to a female she will be unclean for two weeks [
fourteen days
] as during her menstruation [
‘separation’
]. For sixty-six days she will remain [in the status] that the blood [she sees] is ritually pure.

verses.he: וּבִמְלֹ֣את ׀ יְמֵ֣י טָהֳרָ֗הּ לְבֵן֮ א֣וֹ לְבַת֒ תָּבִ֞יא כֶּ֤בֶשׂ בֶּן־שְׁנָתוֹ֙ לְעֹלָ֔ה וּבֶן־יוֹנָ֥ה אוֹ־תֹ֖ר לְחַטָּ֑את אֶל־פֶּ֥תַח אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵ֖ד אֶל־הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.on: וּבְמִשְׁלַם יוֹמֵי דָכוּתַהּ לִבְרָא אוֹ לִבְרַתָּא תַּיְתִי אִמָר בַּר שַׁתֵּהּ לַעֲלָתָא וּבַר יוֹנָה אוֹ שַׁפְנִינָא לְחַטָאתָא לִתְרַע מַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא לְוַת כַּהֲנָא
verses.en: When the days of her purification are completed, be it for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb, in its first year, as a burnt-offering and a young pigeon or a turtledove as a sin-offering, to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, to the kohein.

oe.t: When the days of her purification are completed, be it for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb, in its first year, as a burnt-offering and a young pigeon or a turtledove as a sin-offering, to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, to the kohein.

verses.he: וְהִקְרִיב֞וֹ לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ וְכִפֶּ֣ר עָלֶ֔יהָ וְטָהֲרָ֖ה מִמְּקֹ֣ר דָּמֶ֑יהָ זֹ֤את תּוֹרַת֙ הַיֹּלֶ֔דֶת לַזָּכָ֖ר א֥וֹ לַנְּקֵבָֽה׃
verses.on: וִיקָרְבִנֵהּ קֳדָם יְיָ וִיכַפֵּר עֲלַהּ וְתִדְכֵּי מִסוֹאֲבַת דְמָהָא דָא אוֹרַיְתָא דְיַלֶדְתָּא לְדוּכְרָא אוֹ לִנְקֻבְתָא
verses.en: He will bring it before Adonoy and atone for her and she will be cleansed from the source of her blood; this is the law regarding the woman who gives birth to a male or to a female.

oe.t: He will bring it before Adonoy and atone for her and she will be cleansed from the source [
impurity
] of her blood; this is the law regarding the woman who gives birth to a male or to a female.

verses.he: וְאִם־לֹ֨א תִמְצָ֣א יָדָהּ֮ דֵּ֣י שֶׂה֒ וְלָקְחָ֣ה שְׁתֵּֽי־תֹרִ֗ים א֤וֹ שְׁנֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֔ה אֶחָ֥ד לְעֹלָ֖ה וְאֶחָ֣ד לְחַטָּ֑את וְכִפֶּ֥ר עָלֶ֛יהָ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְטָהֵֽרָה׃ (פ)
verses.on: וְאִם לָא תַשְׁכַּח יְדַהּ כְּמִסַת אִמְרָא וְתִסַב תַּרְתֵּין שַׁפְנִינִין אוֹ תְרֵין בְּנֵי יוֹנָה חַד לַעֲלָתָא וְחַד לְחַטָאתָא וִיכַפֵּר עֲלַהּ כַּהֲנָא וְתִדְכֵּי
verses.en: If she cannot afford [to acquire] a lamb she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons; one as a burnt-offering and one as a sin-offering. The kohein will atone for her and she will be cleansed.

oe.t: If she cannot afford [to acquire] a lamb she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons; one as a burnt-offering and one as a sin-offering. The kohein will atone for her and she will be cleansed.

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.on: וּמַלִיל יְיָ עִם מֹשֶׁה וְעִם אַהֲרֹן לְמֵימָר
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe and to Aharon, saying:

oe.t: Adonoy spoke to Moshe and to Aharon, saying:

verses.he: אָדָ֗ם כִּֽי־יִהְיֶ֤ה בְעוֹר־בְּשָׂרוֹ֙ שְׂאֵ֤ת אֽוֹ־סַפַּ֙חַת֙ א֣וֹ בַהֶ֔רֶת וְהָיָ֥ה בְעוֹר־בְּשָׂר֖וֹ לְנֶ֣גַע צָרָ֑עַת וְהוּבָא֙ אֶל־אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֔ן א֛וֹ אֶל־אַחַ֥ד מִבָּנָ֖יו הַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃
verses.on: אֱנַשׁ אֲרֵי יְהֵי בִמְשַׁךְ בִּסְרֵהּ עַמְקָא אוֹ עַדְיָא אוֹ בַהֲרָא וִיהֵי בִמְשַׁךְ בִּסְרֵהּ לְמַכְתַּשׁ סְגִירוּ וְיִתֵּתֵי לְוַת אַהֲרֹן כַּהֲנָא אוֹ לְוַת חַד מִבְּנוֹהִי כַּהֲנַיָא
verses.en: When a person will have, in the skin of his flesh a spot of intense whiteness or an off-white spot, or a snow-white spot, and it forms on the skin of his body [like] the plague of tzoraas, he shall be brought to Aharon, the kohein, or to one of his sons, the kohanim.

oe.t: When a person will have, in the skin of his flesh a spot of intense [
deep
] whiteness or an off-white spot, or a snow-white spot, and it forms on the skin of his body [like] the plague of tzoraas, [
‘confinement’
] he shall be brought to Aharon, the kohein, or to one of his sons, the kohanim.

verses.he: וְרָאָ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֣ן אֶת־הַנֶּ֣גַע בְּעֽוֹר־הַ֠בָּשָׂר וְשֵׂעָ֨ר בַּנֶּ֜גַע הָפַ֣ךְ ׀ לָבָ֗ן וּמַרְאֵ֤ה הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ עָמֹק֙ מֵע֣וֹר בְּשָׂר֔וֹ נֶ֥גַע צָרַ֖עַת ה֑וּא וְרָאָ֥הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְטִמֵּ֥א אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וְיֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא יָת מַכְתָּשָׁא בִמְשַׁךְ בִּסְרָא וְשֵׂעָר בְּמַכְתָּשָׁא אִתְהַפִיךְ לְמֶחֱוָר וּמֶחֱזֵי מַכְתָּשָׁא עַמִיק בִּמְשַׁךְ בִּסְרֵהּ מַכְתַּשׁ סְגִירוּתָא הוּא וְיֶחֱזִנֵהּ כַּהֲנָא וִיסָאֵב יָתֵהּ
verses.en: The kohein shall see the plague in the skin of the flesh and [if] the hair in the skin-eruption has turned white and the appearance of the plague is deeper than the skin of his body, it is the skin-eruption of tzoraas. The kohein shall see it and declare him [to be] unclean.

oe.t: The kohein shall see the plague in the skin of the flesh and [if] the hair in the skin-eruption has turned white and the appearance of the plague is deeper than the skin of his body, it is the skin-eruption of tzoraas. [
‘confinement’
] The kohein shall see it and declare him [to be] unclean.

verses.he: וְאִם־בַּהֶרֶת֩ לְבָנָ֨ה הִ֜וא בְּע֣וֹר בְּשָׂר֗וֹ וְעָמֹק֙ אֵין־מַרְאֶ֣הָ מִן־הָע֔וֹר וּשְׂעָרָ֖ה לֹא־הָפַ֣ךְ לָבָ֑ן וְהִסְגִּ֧יר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־הַנֶּ֖גַע שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.on: וְאִם בַּהֲרָא חַוְרָא הִיא בִּמְשַׁךְ בִּסְרֵהּ וְעַמִיק לֵית מֶחֱזָהָא מִן מַשְׁכָא וּשְׂעָרָא לָא אִתְהֲפִיךְ לְמֶחֱוָר וְיַסְגַר כַּהֲנָא יָת מַכְתָּשָׁא שִׁבְעָא יוֹמִין
verses.en: If it is a snow-white spot in the skin of the flesh and it does not appear deeper than the skin and the hair did not turn white, the kohein shall confine the plague for seven days.

oe.t: If it is a snow-white spot in the skin of the flesh and it does not appear deeper than the skin and the hair did not turn white, the kohein shall confine the plague for seven days.

verses.he: וְרָאָ֣הוּ הַכֹּהֵן֮ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי֒ וְהִנֵּ֤ה הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ עָמַ֣ד בְּעֵינָ֔יו לֹֽא־פָשָׂ֥ה הַנֶּ֖גַע בָּע֑וֹר וְהִסְגִּיר֧וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֛ן שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים שֵׁנִֽית׃
verses.on: וְיֶחֱזִנֵהּ כַּהֲנָא בְּיוֹמָא שְׁבִיעָאָה וְהָא מַכְתָּשָׁא קָם כַּד הֲוָה לָא אוֹסֵף מַכְתָּשָׁא בְּמַשְׁכָּא וְיַסְגְרִנֵהּ כַּהֲנָא שִׁבְעָא יוֹמִין תִּנְיָנוּת
verses.en: The kohein shall see him on the seventh day and behold! [if] the skin-eruption has maintained its hue; the skin-eruption did not spread in the skin. The kohein shall confine him for seven days, a second time,

oe.t: The kohein shall see him on the seventh day and behold! [if] the skin-eruption has maintained its hue [
remained as it was
]; the skin-eruption did not spread [
increase
] in the skin. The kohein shall confine him for seven days, a second time,

verses.he: וְרָאָה֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן אֹת֜וֹ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי֮ שֵׁנִית֒ וְהִנֵּה֙ כֵּהָ֣ה הַנֶּ֔גַע וְלֹא־פָשָׂ֥ה הַנֶּ֖גַע בָּע֑וֹר וְטִהֲר֤וֹ הַכֹּהֵן֙ מִסְפַּ֣חַת הִ֔יא וְכִבֶּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָהֵֽר׃
verses.on: וְיֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא יָתֵהּ בְּיוֹמָא שְׁבִיעָאָה תִּנְיָנוּת וְהָא עַמְיָא מַכְתָּשָׁא וְלָא אוֹסֵף מַכְתָּשָׁא בְּמַשְׁכָּא וִידַכִּנֵהּ כַּהֲנָא עֲדִיתָא הִיא וִיצַבַּע לְבוּשׁוֹהִי וְיִדְכֵּי
verses.en: The kohein shall see him on the seventh day for the second time and behold! [if] the skin-eruption became dimmer and the skin-eruption did not spread in the skin, the kohein shall declare him [to be] clean; it is [merely] a white discoloration. He shall wash his garments and he will be cleansed.

oe.t: The kohein shall see him on the seventh day for the second time and behold! [if] the skin-eruption became dimmer and the skin-eruption did not spread [
increase
] in the skin, the kohein shall declare him [to be] clean; it is [merely] a [
removed
] white discoloration. He shall wash his garments and he will be cleansed.

verses.he: וְאִם־פָּשֹׂ֨ה תִפְשֶׂ֤ה הַמִּסְפַּ֙חַת֙ בָּע֔וֹר אַחֲרֵ֧י הֵרָאֹת֛וֹ אֶל־הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לְטָהֳרָת֑וֹ וְנִרְאָ֥ה שֵׁנִ֖ית אֶל־הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.on: וְאִם אוֹסָפָא תוֹסֵף עֲדִיתָא בְּמַשְׁכָּא בָּתַר דְאִתְּחֲזִי לְכַהֲנָא לְדַכּוּתֵהּ וְיִתַּחֲזִי תִנְיָנוּת לְכַהֲנָא
verses.en: If the white discoloration has spread in the skin after it was shown to the kohein, who pronounced that it was clean, it must be shown a second time to the kohein.

oe.t: If the [
removed
] white discoloration has spread [
increased
] in the skin after it was shown to the kohein, who pronounced that it was clean, it must be shown a second time to the kohein.

verses.he: וְרָאָה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִנֵּ֛ה פָּשְׂתָ֥ה הַמִּסְפַּ֖חַת בָּע֑וֹר וְטִמְּא֥וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן צָרַ֥עַת הִֽוא׃ (פ)
verses.on: וְיֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא וְהָא אוֹסֵפַת עֲדִיתָא בְּמַשְׁכָּא וִיסָאֵבִנֵהּ כַּהֲנָא סגִירוּתָא הִיא
verses.en: The kohein shall see and behold! [if] the white discoloration has spread in the skin, the kohein shall declare him unclean, it is tzoraas.

oe.t: The kohein shall see and behold! [if] the [
removed
] white discoloration has spread [

verses.on: מַכְתַּשׁ סְגִירוּ אֲרֵי תְהֵי בֶּאֱנָשָׁא ויִתֵּתֵי לְוָת כַּהֲנָא

verses.en: And if the tzoraas sprouts on the skin and if the tzoraas covered the entire skin of the [one affected by] the eruption from his head until his feet to the extent that the kohein can see.

verses.en: The kohein shall see and behold! the tzoraas has covered all of his body, he shall declare the skin-eruption to be cleansed, it has turned completely white, he is clean.

oe.t: The kohein shall see and behold! the tzoraas [

oe.t: On the day that healthy flesh appears on him, he will become unclean.

verses.on: וְיֶחֱזִנֵהּ כַּהֲנָא וְהָא אִתְהֲפִיךְ מַכְתָּשָׁא לְמֶחֱוָר וִידַכֵּי כַהֲנָא יָת מַכְתָּשָׁא דְכֵי הוּא
verses.en: The kohein shall see him, and behold! the skin-eruption has turned white; the kohein shall declare the skin-eruption to be clean, he is clean.

oe.t: The kohein shall see him, and behold! the skin-eruption has turned white; the kohein shall declare the skin-eruption to be clean, he is clean.

verses.he: וּבָשָׂ֕ר כִּֽי־יִהְיֶ֥ה בֽוֹ־בְעֹר֖וֹ שְׁחִ֑ין וְנִרְפָּֽא׃
verses.on: וּבִסְרָא אֲרֵי יְהֵי בֵהּ בְּמַשְּׁכֵּהּ שִׁחֲנָא וְיִתַּסֵי
verses.en: When a person has on his skin an inflammation that has healed.

oe.t: When a person has on his skin an inflammation that has healed.

verses.he: וְהָיָ֞ה בִּמְק֤וֹם הַשְּׁחִין֙ שְׂאֵ֣ת לְבָנָ֔ה א֥וֹ בַהֶ֖רֶת לְבָנָ֣ה אֲדַמְדָּ֑מֶת וְנִרְאָ֖ה אֶל־הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

verses.en: If there was on the area of the inflammation a spot of intense whiteness or a snow-white spot tinged with red it shall be shown to the kohein.

verses.on: וְיֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא וְהָא מֶחֱזָהָא מַכִּיךְ מִן מַשְׁכָּא וּשְׂעָרַהּ אִתְהַפִיךְ לְמֶחֱוָר וִיסָאֵבִינֵהּ כַּהֲנָא מַכְתַּשׁ סְגִירוּתָא הִיא בְּשִׁחַנָא סְגִיאַת
verses.en: The kohein shall see it and behold! its appearance is lower than the skin, and its hair has turned white, the kohein shall declare him unclean; It is the skin-eruption of tzoraas that has sprouted through the inflammation.

] that has sprouted through the inflammation.

verses.en: If the kohein looks at it and behold! there is no white hair in it, and it is not lower than the skin and it is faint, the kohein shall confine him for seven days.

oe.t: If the kohein looks at it and behold! there is no white hair in it, and it is not lower than the skin and it is faint, the kohein shall confine him for seven days.

verses.en: The kohein shall see him on the seventh day. If it has spread in the skin, the kohein shall declare him unclean, it is the skin-eruption of tzoraas.

oe.t: The kohein shall see him on the seventh day. If it has spread [
increased
] in the skin, the kohein shall declare him unclean, it is the skin-eruption of tzoraas. [
‘confinement’

verses.he: וְאִם־תַּחְתֶּיהָ֩ תַעֲמֹ֨ד הַבַּהֶ֜רֶת לֹא־פָשְׂתָ֤ה בָעוֹר֙ וְהִ֣וא כֵהָ֔ה שְׂאֵ֥ת הַמִּכְוָ֖ה הִ֑וא וְטִֽהֲרוֹ֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן כִּֽי־צָרֶ֥בֶת הַמִּכְוָ֖ה הִֽוא׃ (פ)
verses.on: וְאִם בְּאַתְרָהָא קָמַת בַּהֶרְתָּא לָא אוֹסֵפַת בְּמַשְׁכָּא וְהִיא עָמְיָא עוֹמֶק כְּוָאָה הִיא וִידַכִּנֵהּ כַּהֲנָא אֲרֵי רֹשֶׁם כְּוָאָה הִיא
verses.en: If the snow-white spot remains in its place and it did not spread in the skin and it is faint, it is the white spot of the burn. The kohein shall declare him clean for it is [merely] the scar of the burn.

oe.t: If the snow-white spot remains in its place and it did not spread [
increase
] in the skin and it is faint, it is the [
deep
] white spot of the burn. The kohein shall declare him clean for it is [merely] the scar [
impression
] of the burn.

verses.he: וְאִישׁ֙ א֣וֹ אִשָּׁ֔ה כִּֽי־יִהְיֶ֥ה ב֖וֹ נָ֑גַע בְּרֹ֖אשׁ א֥וֹ בְזָקָֽן׃
verses.on: וּגְבַר אוֹ אִתְּתָא אֲרֵי יְהֵא בֵהּ מַכְתָּשָׁא בְּרֵישׁ אוֹ בִּדְקָן
verses.en: If a man or a woman will have a skin-eruption on the head or in the beard.

oe.t: If a man or a woman will have a skin-eruption on the head or in the beard.

verses.he: וְרָאָ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־הַנֶּ֗גַע וְהִנֵּ֤ה מַרְאֵ֙הוּ֙ עָמֹ֣ק מִן־הָע֔וֹר וּב֛וֹ שֵׂעָ֥ר צָהֹ֖ב דָּ֑ק וְטִמֵּ֨א אֹת֤וֹ הַכֹּהֵן֙ נֶ֣תֶק ה֔וּא צָרַ֧עַת הָרֹ֛אשׁ א֥וֹ הַזָּקָ֖ן הֽוּא׃
verses.on: וְיֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא יָת מַכְתָּשָׁא וְהָא מֶחֱזוֹהִי עַמִיק מִן מַשְׁכָּא וּבֵהּ שֵׂעָר סֻמָק דַעְדָק וִיסָאֵב יָתֵהּ כַּהֲנָא נִתְקָא הוּא סְגִירוּת רֵישָׁא אוֹ דִקְנָא הוּא
verses.en: The kohein shall see the skin-eruption, and behold! its appearance is deeper than the skin and there is thin golden hair in it. The kohein shall pronounce it unclean, It is a nesek, it is tzoraas of the head or the beard.

oe.t: The kohein shall see the skin-eruption, and behold! its appearance is deeper than the skin and there is thin golden [
reddish
] hair in it. The kohein shall pronounce it unclean, It is a nesek, it is tzoraas [
‘confinement’
] of the head or the beard.

verses.he: וְכִֽי־יִרְאֶ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־נֶ֣גַע הַנֶּ֗תֶק וְהִנֵּ֤ה אֵין־מַרְאֵ֙הוּ֙ עָמֹ֣ק מִן־הָע֔וֹר וְשֵׂעָ֥ר שָׁחֹ֖ר אֵ֣ין בּ֑וֹ וְהִסְגִּ֧יר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־נֶ֥גַע הַנֶּ֖תֶק שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.on: וַאֲרֵי יֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא יָת מַכְתַּשׁ נִתְקָא וְהָא לֵית מֶחֱזוֹהִי עַמִיק מִן מַשְּׁכָּא וְשֵׂעָר אֻכָם לֵית בֵּיהּ וְיַסְגַר כַּהֲנָא יָת מַכְתַּשׁ נִתְקָא שִׁבְעַת יוֹמִין
verses.en: When the kohein will see the skin eruption of nesek—and behold! it does not appear deeper than the skin and there is no black hair in it, the kohein shall confine [the one affected by] the skin-eruption of the nesek for seven days.

oe.t: When the kohein will see the skin eruption of nesek—and behold! it does not appear deeper than the skin and there is no black hair in it, the kohein shall confine [the one affected by] the skin-eruption of the nesek for seven days.

verses.he: וְרָאָ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֣ן אֶת־הַנֶּגַע֮ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי֒ וְהִנֵּה֙ לֹא־פָשָׂ֣ה הַנֶּ֔תֶק וְלֹא־הָ֥יָה ב֖וֹ שֵׂעָ֣ר צָהֹ֑ב וּמַרְאֵ֣ה הַנֶּ֔תֶק אֵ֥ין עָמֹ֖ק מִן־הָעֽוֹר׃
verses.on: וְיֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא יָת מַכְתָּשָׁא בְּיוֹמָא שְׁבִיעָאָה וְהָא לָא אוֹסֵף נִתְקָא וְלָא הֲוָה בֵהּ שֵׂעָר סֻמָק וּמֶחֱזֵי נִתְקָא לֵית עַמִיק מִן מַשְׁכָּא
verses.en: The kohein shall see the skin-eruption on the seventh day, and behold! the nesek did not spread and there was no golden hair in it and the appearance of the nesek is not deeper than the skin.

oe.t: The kohein shall see the skin-eruption on the seventh day, and behold! the nesek did not spread [
increase
] and there was no golden [
reddish
] hair in it and the appearance of the nesek is not deeper than the skin.

verses.he: וְהִ֨תְגַּלָּ֔ח וְאֶת־הַנֶּ֖תֶק לֹ֣א יְגַלֵּ֑חַ וְהִסְגִּ֨יר הַכֹּהֵ֧ן אֶת־הַנֶּ֛תֶק שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים שֵׁנִֽית׃
verses.on: וִיגַלַח סָחֳרָנֵי נִתְקָא וּדְעִם נִתְקָא לָא יְגַלַח וְיַסְגַר כַּהֲנָא יָת נִתְקָא שִׁבְעָא יוֹמִין תִּנְיָנוּת
verses.en: He shall be shaved but he shall not shave the nesek, and the kohein shall confine the nesek for a second seven day period.

oe.t: He shall be shaved [
shave around the nesek
] but he shall not shave [
close to
] the nesek, and the kohein shall confine the nesek for a second seven day period.

verses.he: וְרָאָה֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן אֶת־הַנֶּ֜תֶק בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י וְ֠הִנֵּה לֹא־פָשָׂ֤ה הַנֶּ֙תֶק֙ בָּע֔וֹר וּמַרְאֵ֕הוּ אֵינֶ֥נּוּ עָמֹ֖ק מִן־הָע֑וֹר וְטִהַ֤ר אֹתוֹ֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְכִבֶּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖יו וְטָהֵֽר׃
verses.on: וְיֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא יָת נִתְקָא בְּיוֹמָא שְׁבִיעָאָה וְהָא לָא אוֹסֵף נִתְקָא בְּמַשְׁכָּא וּמֶחֱזוֹהִי לֵיתוֹהִי עַמִיק מִן מַשְׁכָּא וִידַכֵּי יָתֵהּ כַּהֲנָא וִיצַבַּע לְבוּשׁוֹהִי וְיִדְכֵּי
verses.en: The kohein shall see the nesek on the seventh day and behold! if the nesek did not spread in the skin and its appearance is not deeper than the skin. The kohein shall declare him clean. He shall wash his garments and he will be clean.

oe.t: The kohein shall see the nesek on the seventh day and behold! if the nesek did not spread [
increase
] in the skin and its appearance is not deeper than the skin. The kohein shall declare him clean. He shall wash his garments and he will be clean.

verses.he: וְאִם־פָּשֹׂ֥ה יִפְשֶׂ֛ה הַנֶּ֖תֶק בָּע֑וֹר אַחֲרֵ֖י טָהֳרָתֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וְאִם אוֹסָפָא יוֹסֵף נִתְקָא בְּמַשְׁכָּא בָּתַר דָכוּתֵהּ
verses.en: If the nesek spreads [extensively] in the skin after he is pronounced clean,

oe.t: If the nesek spreads [
increases
] [extensively] in the skin after he is pronounced clean,

verses.he: וְרָאָ֙הוּ֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִנֵּ֛ה פָּשָׂ֥ה הַנֶּ֖תֶק בָּע֑וֹר לֹֽא־יְבַקֵּ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן לַשֵּׂעָ֥ר הַצָּהֹ֖ב טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא׃
verses.on: וְיֶחֱזִנֵהּ כַּהֲנָא וְהָא אוֹסֵף נִתְקָא בְּמַשְׁכָּא לָא יְבַקֵר כַּהֲנָא לְשֵׂעָר סֻמָק מְסָאָב הוּא
verses.en: the kohein shall see him and behold! the nesek has spread in the skin. The kohein shall not [even] look for golden hair, he is unclean.

oe.t: the kohein shall see him and behold! the nesek has spread [
increased
] in the skin. The kohein shall not [even] look for golden [
reddish
] hair, he is unclean.

verses.he: וְאִם־בְּעֵינָיו֩ עָמַ֨ד הַנֶּ֜תֶק וְשֵׂעָ֨ר שָׁחֹ֧ר צָֽמַח־בּ֛וֹ נִרְפָּ֥א הַנֶּ֖תֶק טָה֣וֹר ה֑וּא וְטִהֲר֖וֹ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃ (ס)
verses.on: וְאִם כַּד הֲוָה קָם נִתְקָא וְשֵׂעָר אֻכָּם צְמַח בֵּהּ אִתַּסִי נִתְקָא דְכֵי הוּא וִידַכִּנֵהּ כַּהֲנָא
verses.en: If the nesek remained the same as it was and black hair grew in it, the nesek is healed, he is clean, and the kohein shall declare him clean.

oe.t: If the nesek remained the same as it was and black hair grew in it, the nesek is healed, he is clean, and the kohein shall declare him clean.

verses.he: וְאִישׁ֙ אֽוֹ־אִשָּׁ֔ה כִּֽי־יִהְיֶ֥ה בְעוֹר־בְּשָׂרָ֖ם בֶּהָרֹ֑ת בֶּהָרֹ֖ת לְבָנֹֽת׃
verses.on: וגְבַר אוֹ אִתְּתָא אֲרֵי יְהֵי בִמְשַׁךְ בִּסְרְהוֹן בַּהֲרָן בַּהֲרָן חַוְרָן
verses.en: When a man or a woman have in the skin of their flesh—white spots.

oe.t: When a man or a woman have in the skin of their flesh—white spots.

verses.he: וְרָאָ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְהִנֵּ֧ה בְעוֹר־בְּשָׂרָ֛ם בֶּהָרֹ֖ת כֵּה֣וֹת לְבָנֹ֑ת בֹּ֥הַק ה֛וּא פָּרַ֥ח בָּע֖וֹר טָה֥וֹר הֽוּא׃ (ס)
verses.on: וְיֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא וְהָא בִמְשַׁךְ בִּסְרְהוֹן בַּהֲרָן עָמְיָן חַוְרָן בָּהֲקָא הוּא סָגֵי בְמַשְׁכָּא דְכֵי הוּא
verses.en: The kohein shall see, and behold! in the skin of their flesh are dim white spots, it is [merely] scurf that has sprouted in the skin; it is clean.

oe.t: The kohein shall see, and behold! in the skin of their flesh are dim white spots, it is [merely] scurf that has sprouted in the skin; it is clean.

verses.he: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּ֥י יִמָּרֵ֖ט רֹאשׁ֑וֹ קֵרֵ֥חַ ה֖וּא טָה֥וֹר הֽוּא׃
verses.on: וּגְבַר אֲרֵי יַתַּר שְׂעַר רֵישֵׁהּ קְרַח הוּא דְכֵי הוּא
verses.en: If a mans hair falls out, he is [merely] bald; he is clean.

oe.t: If a mans hair falls out, he is [merely] bald; he is clean.

verses.he: וְאִם֙ מִפְּאַ֣ת פָּנָ֔יו יִמָּרֵ֖ט רֹאשׁ֑וֹ גִּבֵּ֥חַ ה֖וּא טָה֥וֹר הֽוּא׃
verses.on: וְאִם מִלָקֳבֵל אַפּוֹהִי יַתַּר שְׂעַר רֵישֵׁהּ גְלוֹשׁ הוּא דְכֵי הוּא
verses.en: If, on the front of his head his hair falls out, he is [merely] frontally bald; he is clean.

oe.t: If, on the front of his head his hair falls out, he is [merely] frontally bald; he is clean.

verses.he: וְכִֽי־יִהְיֶ֤ה בַקָּרַ֙חַת֙ א֣וֹ בַגַּבַּ֔חַת נֶ֖גַע לָבָ֣ן אֲדַמְדָּ֑ם צָרַ֤עַת פֹּרַ֙חַת֙ הִ֔וא בְּקָרַחְתּ֖וֹ א֥וֹ בְגַבַּחְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וַאֲרֵי יְהֵי בְקָרָחוּתֵהּ אוֹ בִגְלוֹשׁוּתֵהּ מַכְתַּשׁ חִוָר סַמוֹק סְגִירוּת סָגְיָא הִיא בְּקָרָחוּתֵהּ אוֹ בִגְלוֹשּׁוּתֵהּ
verses.en: If there will be, in the baldness in back of the head or in the baldness in front of the head a white skin-eruption, tinged with red, it is tzoraas sprouting in his frontal baldness or in his posterior baldness.

oe.t: If there will be, in the baldness in back of the head or in the baldness in front of the head a white skin-eruption, tinged with red, it is tzoraas [
‘confinement’
] sprouting in his frontal baldness or in his posterior baldness.

verses.he: וְרָאָ֨ה אֹת֜וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְהִנֵּ֤ה שְׂאֵת־הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ לְבָנָ֣ה אֲדַמְדֶּ֔מֶת בְּקָרַחְתּ֖וֹ א֣וֹ בְגַבַּחְתּ֑וֹ כְּמַרְאֵ֥ה צָרַ֖עַת ע֥וֹר בָּשָֽׂר׃
verses.on: וְיֶחֱזֵי יָתֵהּ כַּהֲנָא וְהָא עַמִיק מַכְתָּשָׁא חַוְרָא סַמְקָא בְּקָרָחוּתֵהּ אוֹ בִגְלוֹשׁוּתֵהּ כְּמֶחֱזֵי סְגִירוּתָא מְשַׁךְ בִּסְרָא
verses.en: The kohein shall see him, and behold! the spot of intense whiteness is tinged with red in his frontal baldness or in his posterior baldness just as the appearance tzoraas of the skin of the flesh.

oe.t: The kohein shall see him, and behold! the spot of intense [
deep
] whiteness is tinged with red in his frontal baldness or in his posterior baldness just as the appearance tzoraas [
‘confinement’
] of the skin of the flesh.

verses.he: אִישׁ־צָר֥וּעַ ה֖וּא טָמֵ֣א ה֑וּא טַמֵּ֧א יְטַמְּאֶ֛נּוּ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן בְּרֹאשׁ֥וֹ נִגְעֽוֹ׃
verses.on: גְבַר סְגִיר הוּא מְסָאָב הוּא סָאֳבָא יְסָאֵבִנֵהּ כַּהֲנָא בְּרֵישֵּׁהּ מַכְתָּשֵׁהּ
verses.en: He is a person with tzoraas, he is unclean. The kohein shall declare him unclean; his skin-eruption is on his head.

oe.t: He is a person with tzoraas, [
‘confinement’
] he is unclean. The kohein shall declare him unclean; his skin-eruption is on his head.

verses.he: וְהַצָּר֜וּעַ אֲשֶׁר־בּ֣וֹ הַנֶּ֗גַע בְּגָדָ֞יו יִהְי֤וּ פְרֻמִים֙ וְרֹאשׁוֹ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה פָר֔וּעַ וְעַל־שָׂפָ֖ם יַעְטֶ֑ה וְטָמֵ֥א ׀ טָמֵ֖א יִקְרָֽא׃
verses.on: וּסְגִירָא דִי בֵהּ מַכְתָּשָׁא לְבוּשׁוֹהִי יְהוֹן מְבַזְעִין וְרֵישֵׁהּ יְהֵי פְרִיעַ וְעַל שָׂפָם כַּאֲבֵלָא יִתְעַטָף וְלָא תִסְתַּאֲבוּן וְלָא תִסְתַּאֲבוּן יִקְרֵי
verses.en: The tzorua—[the person] who has the skin-eruption—his garments shall have a tear in them, his hair shall be grown long, and he must cover his head down to his upper lip, and Unclean, unclean, shall he call out.

oe.t: The tzorua [
one who is ‘confined’
]—[the person] who has the skin-eruption—his garments shall have a tear in them, his hair shall be grown long, and he must cover his head down to his upper lip [
like a mourner
], and [
do not become
] Unclean, [
do not become
] unclean, shall he call out.

verses.he: כָּל־יְמֵ֞י אֲשֶׁ֨ר הַנֶּ֥גַע בּ֛וֹ יִטְמָ֖א טָמֵ֣א ה֑וּא בָּדָ֣ד יֵשֵׁ֔ב מִח֥וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה מוֹשָׁבֽוֹ׃ (ס)
verses.on: כָּל יוֹמֵי דִי מַכְתָּשָּׁא בֵהּ יְהֵי מְסָאָב מְסָאָב הוּא בִּלְחוֹדוֹהִי יֵיתֵב מִבָּרָא לְמַשְׁרִיתָא מוֹתְבֵהּ
verses.en: All the days in which the skin-eruption is on him he shall be unclean; he is unclean. He shall dwell alone; his dwelling shall be beyond the encampment.

oe.t: All the days in which the skin-eruption is on him he shall be unclean; he is unclean. He shall dwell alone; his dwelling shall be beyond the encampment.

verses.he: וְהַבֶּ֕גֶד כִּֽי־יִהְיֶ֥ה ב֖וֹ נֶ֣גַע צָרָ֑עַת בְּבֶ֣גֶד צֶ֔מֶר א֖וֹ בְּבֶ֥גֶד פִּשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.on: וּלְבוּשָׁא אֲרֵי יְהֵי בֵהּ מַכְתַּשׁ סְגִירוּ בִּלְבֻשׁ עֲמַר אוֹ בִּלְבוּשׁ כִּתָּן
verses.en: When in a garment there is a skin-eruption of tzoraas, whether a woolen garment or in a linen garment.

oe.t: When in a garment there is a skin-eruption of tzoraas, [
‘confinement’
] whether a woolen garment or in a linen garment.

verses.he: א֤וֹ בִֽשְׁתִי֙ א֣וֹ בְעֵ֔רֶב לַפִּשְׁתִּ֖ים וְלַצָּ֑מֶר א֣וֹ בְע֔וֹר א֖וֹ בְּכָל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֽוֹר׃
verses.on: אוֹ בְשִׁתְיָא אוֹ בְעַרְבָא לְכִתָּנָא וּלְעַמְרָא אוֹ בְמַשְׁכָּא אוֹ בְּכָל עֲבִידַת מְשָׁךְ
verses.en: Or if it is the warp [lengthwise] threads, or in the woof [widthwise] threads, in a linen garment, or a woolen garment, or on leather or in any object made of leather.

oe.t: Or if it is the warp [lengthwise] threads, or in the woof [widthwise] threads, in a linen garment, or a woolen garment, or on leather or in any object made of leather.

verses.he: וְהָיָ֨ה הַנֶּ֜גַע יְרַקְרַ֣ק ׀ א֣וֹ אֲדַמְדָּ֗ם בַּבֶּגֶד֩ א֨וֹ בָע֜וֹר אֽוֹ־בַשְּׁתִ֤י אוֹ־בָעֵ֙רֶב֙ א֣וֹ בְכָל־כְּלִי־ע֔וֹר נֶ֥גַע צָרַ֖עַת ה֑וּא וְהָרְאָ֖ה אֶת־הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.on: וִיהֵי מַכְתָּשָׁא יָרוֹק אוֹ סַמוֹק בִּלְבוּשָׁא אוֹ בְמַשְׁכָּא אוֹ בְשִׁתְיָא אוֹ בְעַרְבָא אוֹ בְכָל מַאן דִמְשַׁךְ מַכְתַּשׁ סְגִירוּתָא הוּא וְיִתַּחֲזֵי לְכַהֲנָא
verses.en: If the plague is deep green or deep red, in the garment, or in the leather hide or in the warp threads, or in the woof threads, or if it is in any object made of leather; it is the eruption of tzoraas and it shall be shown to the kohein.

oe.t: If the plague is deep green or deep red [
green or red
], in the garment, or in the leather hide or in the warp threads, or in the woof threads, or if it is in any object made of leather; it is the eruption of tzoraas [
‘confinement’
] and it shall be shown to the kohein.

verses.he: וְרָאָ֥ה הַכֹּהֵ֖ן אֶת־הַנָּ֑גַע וְהִסְגִּ֥יר אֶת־הַנֶּ֖גַע שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.on: וְיֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא יָת מַכְתָּשָׁא וְיַסְגַר יָת מַכְתָּשָׁא שִׁבְעַת יוֹמִין
verses.en: The kohein shall see the plague and confine the eruption, for seven days.

oe.t: The kohein shall see the plague and confine the eruption, for seven days.

verses.he: וְרָאָ֨ה אֶת־הַנֶּ֜גַע בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י כִּֽי־פָשָׂ֤ה הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ בַּ֠בֶּגֶד אֽוֹ־בַשְּׁתִ֤י אֽוֹ־בָעֵ֙רֶב֙ א֣וֹ בָע֔וֹר לְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־יֵעָשֶׂ֥ה הָע֖וֹר לִמְלָאכָ֑ה צָרַ֧עַת מַמְאֶ֛רֶת הַנֶּ֖גַע טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא׃
verses.on: וְיֶחֱזֵי יָת מַכְתָּשָׁא בְּיוֹמָא שְׁבִיעָאָה אֲרֵי אוֹסֵף מַכְתָּשָּׁא בִּלְבוּשָׁא אוֹ בְשִׁתְיָא אוֹ בְעַרְבָא אוֹ בְמַשְׁכָּא לְכֹל דִי יִתְעֲבֵד מַשְׁכָּא לְעִבִידָא סְגִירוּת מְחַסְרָא מַכְתָּשָׁא מְסָאָב הוּא
verses.en: He shall see the eruption on the seventh day. If the eruption has spread in the garment or in the warp thread, or in the woof thread, or in the leather hide, or in the work made of leather, it is a prickly tzoraas, it is unclean.

oe.t: He shall see the eruption on the seventh day. If the eruption has spread [
increased
] in the garment or in the warp thread, or in the woof thread, or in the leather hide, or in the work made of leather, it is a prickly tzoraas, [
‘confinement’ of loss
] it is unclean.

verses.he: וְשָׂרַ֨ף אֶת־הַבֶּ֜גֶד א֥וֹ אֶֽת־הַשְּׁתִ֣י ׀ א֣וֹ אֶת־הָעֵ֗רֶב בַּצֶּ֙מֶר֙ א֣וֹ בַפִּשְׁתִּ֔ים א֚וֹ אֶת־כָּל־כְּלִ֣י הָע֔וֹר אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶ֥ה ב֖וֹ הַנָּ֑גַע כִּֽי־צָרַ֤עַת מַמְאֶ֙רֶת֙ הִ֔וא בָּאֵ֖שׁ תִּשָּׂרֵֽף׃
verses.on: וְיוֹקִיד יָת לְבוּשָׁא אוֹ יָת שִׁתְיָא אוֹ יָת עַרְבָא בְעַמְרָא אוֹ בְכִתָּנָא אוֹ יָת כָּל מָאן דִמְשַׁךְ דִי יְהֵי בֵהּ מַכְתָּשָׁא אֲרֵי סְגִירוּת מְחַסְרָא הִיא בְּנוּרָא תִּתּוֹקָד
verses.en: He shall burn the garment, or the warp [lengthwise] threads, or the woof [widthwise] threads, be it in wool or in linen, or in all leather made objects, in which there is the eruption. For it is a prickly tzoraas. It shall be burned in fire.

oe.t: He shall burn the garment, or the warp [lengthwise] threads, or the woof [widthwise] threads, be it in wool or in linen, or in all leather made objects, in which there is the eruption. For it is a prickly tzoraas. [
‘confinement’ of loss
] It shall be burned in fire.

verses.he: וְאִם֮ יִרְאֶ֣ה הַכֹּהֵן֒ וְהִנֵּה֙ לֹא־פָשָׂ֣ה הַנֶּ֔גַע בַּבֶּ֕גֶד א֥וֹ בַשְּׁתִ֖י א֣וֹ בָעֵ֑רֶב א֖וֹ בְּכָל־כְּלִי־עֽוֹר׃
verses.on: וְאִם יֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא וְהָא לָא אוֹסֵף מַכְתָּשָׁא בִּלְבוּשָׁא אוֹ בְשִׁתְיָא אוֹ בְעַרְבָא אוֹ בְּכָל מָאן דִמְשָׁךְ
verses.en: If the kohein will see, and behold! the eruption did not spread in the garment, or in the warp threads, or in the woof threads, or in any leather made object.

oe.t: If the kohein will see, and behold! the eruption did not spread [
increase
] in the garment, or in the warp threads, or in the woof threads, or in any leather made object.

verses.he: וְצִוָּה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְכִ֨בְּס֔וּ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־בּ֖וֹ הַנָּ֑גַע וְהִסְגִּיר֥וֹ שִׁבְעַת־יָמִ֖ים שֵׁנִֽית׃
verses.on: וִיפַקֵד כַּהֲנָא וִיחַוְרוּן יָת דִי בֵהּ מַכְתָּשָׁא וְיַסְגְרִנֵהּ שִׁבְעַת יוֹמִין תִּנְיָנוּת
verses.en: The kohein shall command that they shall wash the article having the eruption, and confine it for seven days, a second time.

oe.t: The kohein shall command that they shall wash the article having the eruption, and confine it for seven days, a second time.

verses.he: וְרָאָ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אַחֲרֵ֣י ׀ הֻכַּבֵּ֣ס אֶת־הַנֶּ֗גַע וְ֠הִנֵּה לֹֽא־הָפַ֨ךְ הַנֶּ֤גַע אֶת־עֵינוֹ֙ וְהַנֶּ֣גַע לֹֽא־פָשָׂ֔ה טָמֵ֣א ה֔וּא בָּאֵ֖שׁ תִּשְׂרְפֶ֑נּוּ פְּחֶ֣תֶת הִ֔וא בְּקָרַחְתּ֖וֹ א֥וֹ בְגַבַּחְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וְיֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא בָּתַר דְחַוָרוּ יָת מַכְתָּשָׁא וְהָא לָא שְׁנָא מַכְתָּשָׁא מִן כַּד הֲוָה וּמַכְתָּשָׁא לָא אוֹסֵף מְסָאָב הוּא בְּנוּרָא תּוֹקְדִנֵהּ תַּבְרָא הִיא בִּשְׁחִיקוּתֵהּ אוֹ בחַדָתוּתֵהּ
verses.en: The kohein shall see it after the eruption was washed and behold! [even if] the eruption did not change its hue and the eruption did not spread; it is unclean, you shall burn it in fire. It is a deep mark be it in a worn [garment] or in a new [garment].

oe.t: The kohein shall see it after the eruption was washed and behold! [even if] the eruption did not change its hue [
from what it was
] and the eruption did not spread [
increase
]; it is unclean, you shall burn it in fire. It is a deep mark [
break
] be it in a worn [garment] or in a new [garment].

verses.he: וְאִם֮ רָאָ֣ה הַכֹּהֵן֒ וְהִנֵּה֙ כֵּהָ֣ה הַנֶּ֔גַע אַחֲרֵ֖י הֻכַּבֵּ֣ס אֹת֑וֹ וְקָרַ֣ע אֹת֗וֹ מִן־הַבֶּ֙גֶד֙ א֣וֹ מִן־הָע֔וֹר א֥וֹ מִן־הַשְּׁתִ֖י א֥וֹ מִן־הָעֵֽרֶב׃
verses.on: וְאִם חֲזָא כַהֲנָא וְהָא עָמְיָא מַכְתָּשָׁא בָּתַר דְחַוָרוּ יָתֵהּ וּבְזַע יָתֵהּ מִן לְבוּשָׁא אוֹ מִן מַשְׁכָּא אוֹ מִן שִׁתְיָא אוֹ מִן עַרְבָא
verses.en: If the kohein saw and behold! the eruption grew faint after it was washed; he shall tear it from the garment, or from the leather, or from the warp threads or from the woof threads.

oe.t: If the kohein saw and behold! the eruption grew faint after it was washed; he shall tear it from the garment, or from the leather, or from the warp threads or from the woof threads.

verses.he: וְאִם־תֵּרָאֶ֨ה ע֜וֹד בַּ֠בֶּגֶד אֽוֹ־בַשְּׁתִ֤י אֽוֹ־בָעֵ֙רֶב֙ א֣וֹ בְכָל־כְּלִי־ע֔וֹר פֹּרַ֖חַת הִ֑וא בָּאֵ֣שׁ תִּשְׂרְפֶ֔נּוּ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־בּ֖וֹ הַנָּֽגַע׃
verses.on: וְאִם תִּתְחֲזֵי עוֹד בִּלְבוּשָׁא אוֹ בְשִׁתְיָא אוֹ בְעַרְבָא אוֹ בְכָל מָאן דִמְשַׁךְ סָגְיָא הִיא בְּנוּרָא תוֹקְדִנֵהּ יָת דִי בֵהּ מַכְתָּשָׁא
verses.en: If it will appear again, in the garment or in the warp [lengthwise] threads, or in the woof [widthwise] threads, or in any leather-made object, it is a recurrent outbreak of tzoraas. You shall burn the article having the eruption in fire.

oe.t: If it will appear again, in the garment or in the warp [lengthwise] threads, or in the woof [widthwise] threads, or in any leather-made object, it is a recurrent outbreak of tzoraas. You shall burn the article having the eruption in fire.

verses.he: וְהַבֶּ֡גֶד אֽוֹ־הַשְּׁתִ֨י אוֹ־הָעֵ֜רֶב אֽוֹ־כָל־כְּלִ֤י הָעוֹר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תְּכַבֵּ֔ס וְסָ֥ר מֵהֶ֖ם הַנָּ֑גַע וְכֻבַּ֥ס שֵׁנִ֖ית וְטָהֵֽר׃
verses.on: וּלְבוּשָׁא אוֹ שַׁתְיָא אוֹ עַרְבָא אוֹ כָל מָאן דִמְשָׁךְ דִי יִתְחַוַר וְיֶעְדֵי מִנְהוֹן מַכְתָּשָׁא וְיִצְטַּבַּע תִּנְיָנוּת וְיִדְכֵּי
verses.en: The garment, or the warp threads, or the woof threads, or any leather objects that were washed and the eruption disappears from them, it shall be washed a second time and it shall be purified.

oe.t: The garment, or the warp threads, or the woof threads, or any leather objects that were washed and the eruption disappears from them, it shall be washed a second time and it shall be purified.

verses.he: זֹ֠את תּוֹרַ֨ת נֶֽגַע־צָרַ֜עַת בֶּ֥גֶד הַצֶּ֣מֶר ׀ א֣וֹ הַפִּשְׁתִּ֗ים א֤וֹ הַשְּׁתִי֙ א֣וֹ הָעֵ֔רֶב א֖וֹ כָּל־כְּלִי־ע֑וֹר לְטַהֲר֖וֹ א֥וֹ לְטַמְּאֽוֹ׃ (פ)
verses.on: דָא אוֹרַיְתָא דְמַכְתַּשׁ סְגִירוּ בִּלְבוּשׁ עֲמַר אוֹ כִתָּנָא אוֹ שִׁתְיָא אוֹ עַרְבָא אוֹ כָּל מָאן דִמְשָׁךְ לְדַכָּיוּתֵהּ אוֹ לְסַאֲבוּתֵהּ
verses.en: This is the law of the eruption of tzoraas be it in a woolen garment, or a linen garment, or in the warp [lengthwise] thread, or in the woof [widthwise] thread, or in any leather-made object, that it be pronounced pure, or that it be pronounced impure.

oe.t: This is the law of the eruption of tzoraas [
‘confinement’

] be it in a woolen garment, or a linen garment, or in the warp [lengthwise] thread, or in the woof [widthwise] thread, or in any leather-made object, that it be pronounced pure, or that it be pronounced impure.
